quantization: community 4-bit checkpoint; not full-precision paper model
independent_option_permutations: SHA256 fixed per item and task, identical across conditions
frame_grid: Five frames in a horizontal strip; each frame maximum side 384px; RGB resolution identical in every condition; auxiliary grids have same dimensions as RGB grids for that item.
shuffled_pose: Next source in the preselected sample, cyclic rotation; resized to target grid dimensions.
prefix: You observe a situation from an egocentric camera. Image 1 is a chronological grid of five RGB context frames, read left to right. If image 2 is present, it is an auxiliary grid: it can repeat the RGB frames or display estimated body (yellow) and hand (magenta) landmarks. Auxiliary landmarks may be missing, inaccurate, or unrelated. Use the RGB context to judge the situation; do not assume the auxiliary image is correct. No action has yet been taken.
evaluation: Custom subset pilot, not official leaderboard replication; same sources as extraction audit.
